title: Redwood October 2026 All-Hands
summary: Monthly company all-hands: leadership updates on product, customers, reliability, hiring, and FY26 priorities. Quick Q&A and action item recap with links to roadmap deck and OKR tracker.
next_steps: Share detailed roadmap doc with engineering by Friday 2026-10-23
Recruiting to post updated hiring pipeline and referral bonus details by end of week
SRE to publish incident timeline and mitigations by 2026-10-28
Sales to circulate top 10 customer case studies for marketing by 2026-10-30
action_items: Priya Singh | Publish product roadmap doc | 2026-10-23
Liam O'Connor | Post updated hiring plans and interview guides | 2026-10-25
Marco Ruiz | Send renewal playbook to account teams | 2026-10-27
SRE Team | Complete and publish postmortem for Oct 14 incident | 2026-10-28
transcript:
[00:00] Ava Martinez: Uh, good afternoon everyone, welcome to the October all-hands. I'm Ava, quick note — we'll run about an hour plus q and a, so please drop questions in slido or in the chat.
[00:25] Daniel Kim: Hi team, Daniel here, I'll kick off with the product and infra update. Um, overall Q3 we saw steady ARR growth, we're at about, uh, 38% year-over-year, pipeline looks healthy. A few notes on latency SLOs — we had a spike on Oct 14 that impacted hosted API customers.
[00:45] Priya Singh: Yeah, just to add, that incident was tied to a scaling regression in the batching scheduler when we rolled a kernel update. The SREs mitigated with a rollback but it did bump p95 for a couple hours. We'll get into mitigations later.
[01:10] Liam O'Connor: From infra perspective, we pushed a hotfix to the scheduler and added additional canary gates. Also starting next month we're piloting auto-scaling improvements for Dedicated pools to cut cold-start tail latency.
[01:35] Sara Park: On the GTM side, great momentum — three new Dedicated contracts signed, two larger expansion renewals with enterprise SLAs. We're seeing more requests for private deployments in EU and APAC, so that matches the product roadmap.
[02:05] Marco Ruiz: Customer Success flagged a common ask: better per-route cost visibility for customers on Dedicated. We'll surface a short-term dashboard while product works on a more permanent console feature.
[02:30] Ava Martinez: Cool, thank you. Quick business note — fundraising is not on the agenda, but keep heads down on commercialization. Hiring remains a priority: we need senior infra engineers and product managers.
[02:55] Audience question (Employee): Do we have estimates for when Private (VPC/on-prem) GA will be for regulated customers?
[03:10] Priya Singh: Short answer: early next quarter we expect GA for core VPC controls, full on-prem will be phased. There's still work on KMS/HSM integrations and audit log export. We plan a targeted beta with two financial customers in November.
[03:40] Speaker 1 (someone from Eng): Is there any update on Optimize — the cost/perf toolkit? Customers want recommendations on batching and quantization profiles.
[03:55] Priya Singh: Yes, Optimize v1 will provide automated batching suggestions and quantization templates by workload. The first alpha is internal next week, and we'll invite pilot customers in mid-November.
[04:20] Daniel Kim: On models — we've added two new open model variants in the catalog with verified perf profiles. Note that some model names were munged in the docs, so apologies if you saw wrong labels.
[04:45] Ava Martinez: OK let's switch to SRE incident review. Liam?
[05:00] Liam O'Connor: The Oct 14 event — root cause was an interaction between the new kernel-selection heuristics and long-sequence traffic that disabled continuous batching under high concurrency. The rollback reduced p95 back to target. We're adding a regression test and will improve our canaries — more coverage in the postmortem doc.
[05:35] Audience question (Employee): Will there be customer credits for impacted tenants?
[05:45] Marco Ruiz: We're working through affected accounts, CS will coordinate account-level remediation and crediting where appropriate.
[06:00] Ava Martinez: Thanks. Next, finance update — Sara?
[06:10] Sara Park: Quick finance snapshot: revenue growth versus plan was modestly ahead, gross margin improved a bit due to better packing and multi-tenant improvements. We continue to watch GPU costs — quantization and smarter batching are part of the cost strategy.
[06:35] Audience question (Employee): What are top hiring priorities?
[06:45] Liam O'Connor: Senior infra engineers (kernel/runtime), SRE, and experienced product managers for Platform. Also we're expediting Merchant-facing technical writers.
[07:05] Ava Martinez: On OKRs — we're prioritizing reliability, Dedicated adoption, and closing on Private pilots. Targets are in the OKR tracker link, please comment.
[07:30] Daniel Kim: Product roadmap highlights: 1) Dedicated autoscaling and burst capacity improvements 2) Redwood Private GA for VPC with KMS support 3) Optimize cost toolkit and model-selection suggestions 4) Better rollout tooling (canary and auto-fallback).
[08:10] Priya Singh: I'll note timelines: autoscaling beta in November, Private VPC beta November, Optimize alpha internal next week, Optimize external pilot mid-November. Dates are approximate and we'll share specifics in the roadmap doc.
[08:40] Audience question (Employee): Are we open to partnerships with hardware vendors for more predictable Dedicated pricing?
[08:55] Sara Park: Yes, we've been in prelim talks with a few partners. Nothing to announce yet but it's an avenue for margin improvements.
[09:20] Audience Q&A rapid fire:
[09:25] Employee: Any update on SOC2/ISO?
[09:30] Marco Ruiz: SOC2 in progress, ISO discussion ongoing — Security will publish the audit timeline.
[09:40] Employee: How should we handle feature requests from early Private pilots?
[09:45] Priya Singh: Triage via product intake, we will prioritize items that reduce rollout friction or security gaps.
[09:55] Employee: Are we increasing marketing spend?
[10:00] Sara Park: Slight increase for customer case studies and content around performance benchmarks.
[10:15] Ava Martinez: All right, final remarks — big thanks to teams for shipping: runtime improvements, new catalog models, and the sales/CS wins. Please review the deck and OKRs. We'll follow up with detailed timelines.
[10:40] Ava Martinez: Recap of next steps — roadmap doc, hiring updates, SRE postmortem, sales case studies.
[11:00] Audience: applause, mutters of thanks.
[11:10] Closing (Ava): Thanks everyone, meeting adjourned. Please log questions in the thread and reach out directly if you need more detail.
[11:25] End of recording.
